**Direct answer:** Global semiconductor sales hit a record in 2024, up about 19% from 2023 and above $600 billion for the first time. The exact figure depends on when it was published. The first SIA/WSTS number was $627.6B (+19.1%). WSTS later revised the year-end total to $630.5B, and its June 2025 table shows +19.7%. Treat $630.5B as the finalized figure. The sources don't say whether WSTS has revised it again since.

**Material claims and sources**

- SIA announced on Feb 7, 2025 that 2024 sales were $627.6B, up 19.1% from $526.8B in 2023.
  https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- SIA later added an update: "WSTS updated 2024 year-end sales to a total of $630.5 billion."
  https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- WSTS's June 2025 table lists 2024 world sales at $630,549M, up 19.7%. Its 2024 regional growth rates were Americas +45.2%, Europe −8.1%, Japan 0.0% and Asia Pacific +16.4%.
  https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf
- WSTS's December 2024 release was a forecast, not a result. It estimated 2024 at $627B (+19.0%) and projected regional growth of Americas +38.9% and Asia Pacific +17.5%. The actual regional rates came out different.
  https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/6765/WSTS_FC-Release-2024_11.pdf
- SIA's February 2025 regional rates used different groupings. They split China out: Americas +44.8%, China +18.3%, Asia Pacific/All Others +12.5%, Japan −0.4%, Europe −8.1%.
  https://www.trendforce.com/news/2025/02/08/news-global-semiconductor-sales-hit-record-high-at-600b-in-2024-set-for-double-digit-growth-in-2025/
- The December 2024 monthly figure ($57.0B, −1.2% from November) is a three-month moving average. It isn't an annual figure.
  https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

**How to tell the three kinds of number apart**

1. **Finalized annual total:** This is a dollar figure for the full year, built from reported monthly data. Use the latest revised WSTS/SIA figure ($630.5B). Note that SIA's first release (Feb 2025) was preliminary.
2. **Forecasts:** These are labeled "projected" or "estimated" and come from a dated WSTS release. The $627B/+19.0% figure came from December 2024, before the year's data was complete. Forecasts for 2025 and 2026 also appear in the same releases and are not 2024 results.
3. **Regional growth rates:** These are year-over-year changes for one region, not global totals. The regional groupings and the vintage of the data change the numbers. For example, Asia Pacific was +16.4% in WSTS's grouping, but SIA split out China (+18.3%) from Asia Pacific/All Others (+12.5%).

**Caveats**
- TrendForce just repeats SIA's preliminary release, so it isn't independent corroboration. The $630.5B revision rests on SIA's update note and WSTS's own table. I found no independent critique or contradicting source.
- I didn't search for later WSTS restatements of the 2024 figure.
- My automated claim check flagged some numbers in the regional claims as not directly quoted. I took them from the cited tables and text, but I'd verify them against the sources before reusing them.

Sources:
- https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf
- https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/6765/WSTS_FC-Release-2024_11.pdf
- https://www.trendforce.com/news/2025/02/08/news-global-semiconductor-sales-hit-record-high-at-600b-in-2024-set-for-double-digit-growth-in-2025/
